consistency.test: H0: live daily mean equals the lab daily mean (2023-26, forward_lab_baseline.json). At each look with >= 30 closed trades: band = 1 % quantile of the means of n-session stationary-bootstrap samples of the lab's daily series (n = the look's sessions); INCONSISTENT iff the live mean < band (one-sided 99 %), CONSISTENT otherwise. INCONSISTENT is latched. Not a promotion.

daily_pnl: per COMPLETE forward session since the strategy's registration: net (after the lab's costs and slippage) of the trades that EXIT that session, zero when none (trials.daily_pnl's convention); INCOMPLETE / skipped sessions are not in the series

data.complete: every listed instrument has >= 360 bars, first bar 09:15, last bar >= 15:14, and both daily series have the session
data.corporate_actions: Kite-adjusted history: when Kite's bars of the previous stored session differ from the stored ones by > 0.05 % (median close ratio), or the NSE corporate-action calendar lists a price-adjusting action ex on the session, the symbol's whole stored window is refetched and replaced; dividends not adjusted (as-traded, the lab's convention); booked trades never change
data.engine_errors: an engine failure is retried at the next run; a second failure records the session as 'error' (skipped for every strategy)
data.incomplete: retried once at the next session's run; still incomplete -> recorded INCOMPLETE and skipped for every strategy (never partial); holidays and special sessions are never run
data.store: anchored: the warm-up is fetched once, one session is appended per day, nothing is deleted; positional strategies use daily bars derived from the minute bars, as in the lab
data.universe: forward_test.UNIVERSE (the lab's 97 NIFTY-100 symbols of bars3y) + _NIFTY50_min + _NIFTYBANK_min (Kite 1-minute) + _NIFTY50_day + _VIX_day (Kite day candles)

demotion.rule: at every evaluation: forward max drawdown of the daily series > 1.5 x the lab's 2023-26 max drawdown of daily net totals of that strategy at lab size (forward_lab_baseline.json refs.max_dd) -> DEMOTED, permanently; no reference (no lab trades) -> demotion cannot fire

forward.family_rule: family_size = every forward strategy ever registered under this rule version (demoted, drifted and removed ones included); it never decreases; strategies added later raise it for later looks only
forward.members: every catalogue strategy (stratlab.api.REGISTRY, native ids, sim.run_symbol at Rs 1 lakh per trade) and every tfgrid portable combo (stratlab.tfgrid.combos(), 1:3 bracket, Rs 10 lakh account)

proven_candidate_sources.AUC-FADE-2PCT: stratlab.auction module runner on the forward bars (Rs 1 lakh, 2.1 bps)
proven_candidate_sources.EV-PEAD-LONG-H60: the agent's own performance-ledger rows (pead_h60), normalised to Rs 1 lakh per trade
proven_candidate_sources.SWING-ATTN-ON-3X: stratlab.attention module runner (Rs 1 lakh, futures costs); entries of a session close at the next session's open
proven_candidate_sources.VRP-STRANGLE-016-WINGED: stratlab.options_vrp (options_replay, Black-Scholes on the NIFTY minute bars, previous VIX close, 2 lots); pending until the expiry day's 15:00-15:29 closes exist

looks.rule: look k at the 20k-th forward session of the strategy (k = 1..12, about one year); the sample is exactly its first 20k sessions; each look is evaluated once, written to the registry chain and never recomputed

qualification.alpha_per_test: alpha_family / (family_size x max_looks) (Bonferroni over the family and the looks)
qualification.permanence: QUALIFIED is permanent unless the strategy is later demoted
qualification.test: H0: mean daily net <= 0. Stationary block bootstrap (Politis-Romano) of the CENTRED daily series; z = mean / sd(bootstrap means); p = 1 - Phi(z). QUALIFIED iff mean > 0 and z >= z_required (equivalently p <= alpha_per_test), with >= min_trades closed trades and >= min_days sessions in the look sample; looks short of either are recorded 'insufficient'

schedule.catch_up: missed sessions are processed in order, at most 5 per run

statement: Written before any forward-lab result existed (no forward session had been run). Do not tune on results: a changed rule is a new version, a changed strategy is a new id (one more test in the family). Nothing here switches anything on: QUALIFIED / CONSISTENT are recorded findings, trading changes and LIVE remain human decisions, and the kept strategies still refuse LIVE.
